summary: Supersedes the earlier live-audit-branch blocker: that malformed audit claim has been released. Trusted control now fails first because completed claims were intentionally expired with leaseSeconds=1, but the authoritative claim schema accepts only 300..14400 seconds. The active owner has been notified; this worker will not rewrite another worker's claim records.
evidence: Latest observed control head 5989fed9d9a259009e194551fa34dbc11d6ef493 fails Swarm Control Plane run 31591053765 in validate-control-branch job 94095840088 after both deterministic swarm test suites pass.
The first validator error is .swarm/claims/HG-BACKFILL-DIAGNOSTICS/test-adversary.json: leaseSeconds out of bounds.
That claim belongs to active worker sol-20260812-q5m8v3n2 and explicitly uses leaseSeconds=1 as an intentional expiry sentinel after completing draft PR #439.
The same worker's stale HG-CAPACITY-MINING/mine-authority claim also uses leaseSeconds=1, so a second schema-invalid record remains behind the first.
Trusted tools/swarm/swarmctl.py validates leaseSeconds in the inclusive 300..14400 range; an out-of-range lease is invalid control data, not a valid stale-claim encoding.
Comment 5265965157 on PR #439 gives the owning lineage the exact failure and safe repair direction. No foreign claim was overwritten or deleted.

metadata.recommendedNext: Owning/recovery lineage should release completed claims through the normal fenced path or retain schema-valid lease metadata. Re-run trusted control validation; do not use leaseSeconds below 300 as an expiry sentinel.
